facts.claim: Disney Dream (Disney Cruise Line): Entered service 2011; 129,750 GT; 2500 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 348 m length; Dream class.
Disney Dream is a cruise ship owned and operated by Disney Cruise Line, a subsidiary of the Walt Disney Company.
She is the third ship in the Disney Cruise Line fleet and the lead vessel of the Dream class.
The ship was followed by her sister ship, Disney Fantasy (2012).

catalogSpecs.description: Dream-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2011; 129,750 GT; approx. 2,500 guests at double occupancy.
